events.body:
Source: Forkmesh QA Bug Report FM-QA-2026-08-02 (BUG-06; supporting screenshot Fig. 1)
Severity: High
Area: Cross-Device / Three.js Rendering
Environment: Web across high-end desktop, mid-tier laptop, mid-tier mobile, and low-tier mobile devices

## Summary
The 3D world is not consistently visible or performant across device classes. Lower-end devices experience lag or rendering failures without an apparent graceful-degradation path.

## Steps to reproduce
1. Open the world section on a high-end desktop, mid-tier laptop, mid-tier mobile device, and low-tier mobile device.
2. Compare element visibility, rendering quality, frame rate, and input or scroll lag.
3. Repeat with browser CPU/GPU throttling and on real low-tier Android hardware.

## Expected
The world remains fully visible and reasonably responsive across supported tiers, reducing particle counts, level of detail, texture quality, shadows, resolution, or draw distance on weaker hardware as needed.

## Actual
The world renders inconsistently and lags on lower-spec devices, with no evident adaptive quality or fallback behavior.

## Investigation notes
Add device-tier detection and dynamic quality scaling. Profile frustum/occlusion culling and pause the render loop while the canvas is off-screen.
